title: Cloud Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 CloudFirst Technology® is a leading provider of cloud\-based solutions, focused on helping businesses succeed through innovative technology and exceptional customer service. The team brings deep expertise in cloud architecture, infrastructure, and security to design and deploy customized solutions tailored to each client’s needs. CloudFirst Technology® supports organizations through every stage of cloud adoption, from detailed assessment and planning to implementation and ongoing optimization. The company is committed to ensuring cloud environments are secure, high\-performing, and cost\-effective for clients across diverse industries.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Cloud Sales Manager is responsible for driving sales growth and expanding the customer base for CloudFirst Technology®’s cloud solutions. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, managing the sales pipeline, conducting product demonstrations, and presenting tailored cloud solution proposals to prospective clients. The Cloud Sales Manager collaborates with technical teams to translate client requirements into viable solutions, negotiates contracts, and ensures a smooth handover from sales to implementation. The role also involves building long\-term relationships, monitoring market trends, and providing feedback to leadership on product and pricing strategies.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong experience in B2B sales, preferably in cloud services, IT infrastructure, or SaaS solutions.
* Proven ability in account management, business development, and relationship building with corporate clients.
* Knowledge of cloud computing concepts, including architecture, security, migration, and cost optimization.
* Skill in consultative selling, solution pitching, negotiation, and closing deals.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage decision\-makers.
* Comfort with CRM tools, pipeline management, and data\-driven sales reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or a related field; relevant certifications are a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with technical and delivery teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Prior experience in the Ahmedabad or broader regional market is beneficial.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Electroparts is a leading industrial solutions provider based in Ahmedabad, specializing in premium electrical, automation, machine hardware, and panel components from globally trusted manufacturers. The company serves OEMs, panel builders, machine manufacturers, system integrators, EPC contractors, and a wide range of industries across Gujarat with genuine products and technical expertise. Electroparts represents renowned brands offering machine elements, access solutions, enclosures, cable management systems, industrial plugs and sockets, and specialized tools. The team is committed to quality, prompt service, and reliable support for applications in automation, electrical panels, machine building, railways, renewable energy, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing. Electroparts positions itself as a trusted partner for industrial components and automation solutions, providing long\-term value to its customers.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Sales Coordinator role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Ahmedabad. The Sales Coordinator will support the sales team by managing inquiries, preparing quotations, processing orders, and maintaining accurate sales records. This role involves coordinating with customers and internal teams, tracking deliveries, and ensuring timely communication on order status and product availability. The Sales Coordinator will assist in follow\-ups, updating customer databases, preparing basic sales reports, and supporting day\-to\-day sales operations. The position requires consistent collaboration with the sales team, warehouse, accounts, and vendors to help ensure smooth service and a positive customer experience.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong Sales Coordination skills to handle quotations, order processing, and follow\-ups.
* Customer Service and Communication skills to manage inquiries, resolve issues, and maintain professional relationships.
* Sales and Sales Operations skills to support pipeline management, reporting, and coordination with the sales team.
* Basic understanding of industrial electrical and automation components is an advantage.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel) and familiarity with ERP or CRM systems.
* Ability to work on\-site in Ahmedabad, manage multiple tasks, and maintain attention to detail.
* Relevant diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Prior experience in industrial distribution, electrical components, or B2B sales support is beneficial.

title: Advertising Sales Manager
description:
**About AdOnMo** 




 AdOnMo is one of India’s leading Out\-of\-Home (OOH) and Digital Out\-of\-Home (DOOH) advertising companies, backed by marquee investors including Zomato, Ant Financial, and Astarc Ventures.
 



 We operate a growing network of 33,000\+ digital screens and 20,000\+ static frame posters across 24\+ major cities, including Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Kochi, Jaipur, and more.
 



 Our advertising solutions are deployed across high\-visibility and high\-footfall environments, including:
 


* Residential societies
* Corporate buildings and coworking spaces
* Gyms and fitness centres
* Shopping malls
* Public and commercial spaces
* Other high\-footfall locations across key markets



 We work with 2,000\+ brands, including Amazon, IKEA, Meta, and Zomato, helping advertisers build targeted and impactful visibility through innovative OOH and DOOH advertising solutions.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for self\-driven and target\-oriented Sales Managers to generate revenue through the sale of OOH and DOOH advertising solutions.
 



 This is a field\-intensive sales role involving client acquisition, business development, client meetings, follow\-ups, relationship management, and achieving monthly revenue targets.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 Key Responsibilities
 


* **1\. Sales Strategy \& Execution**
* Develop and execute business plans to achieve sales and revenue targets.
* Identify new business opportunities and potential areas for market expansion.
* Analyse market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities.
* Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.



  




* **2\. Client Acquisition \& Relationship Management**
* Identify and acquire new clients and business opportunities.
* Conduct sales meetings, presentations, and client discussions.
* Understand client requirements and develop suitable OOH/DOOH advertising solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and account expansion.
* Follow up with clients and agencies to ensure timely payments.



  




* **3\. Agency \& Market Development**
* Build and maintain relationships with advertising agencies, media agencies, and direct clients.
* Develop a strong network within the local advertising and business ecosystem.
* Track market opportunities and actively generate new leads.



  




* **4\. Internal Collaboration**
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of client campaigns.
* Work closely with the marketing team to support lead generation and business development initiatives.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely release and execution of client orders.



  




* **5\. Reporting \& Analysis**
* Maintain regular tracking of leads, prospects, client interactions, and business opportunities.
* Prepare daily call reports, weekly performance updates, monthly sales plans, and sales projections.
* Monitor sales performance and pipeline to ensure achievement of targets.



  




* **6\. Brand Representation**
* Represent AdOnMo professionally in client meetings, industry interactions, and other business forums.
* Promote AdOnMo’s OOH and DOOH advertising solutions to prospective clients and agencies.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Minimum 2\-5 year of experience in field sales, media, advertising, OOH, DOOH, print, digital, or related sales roles.
 


* Experience in B2B sales and client acquisition will be preferred.
* Prior experience working with advertising or media agencies is an advantage.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and target\-oriented approach.
* Strong business development and client relationship management skills.
* Ability to independently manage sales cycles and close deals.
* Good understanding of local market dynamics.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and business development.
* Must own a two\-wheeler or four\-wheeler for regular client visits.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Proactive, go\-getter mindset with a strong drive to achieve targets.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong B2B sales and corporate sales experience.
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and agencies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience in the Advertising, Media, OOH, DOOH, Marketing, or Sales industry will be preferred.



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 AdOnMo is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all candidates based on their skills, experience, and qualifications.

title: Territory Business Associate
description:
**About Aipri Lifesciences LLP** 




 Established in 2025 and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Aipri Lifesciences is an emerging, fast\-growing medical device company dedicated to delivering high\-quality surgical solutions. Founded and led by a medical doctor with extensive cross\-functional experience in clinical research and pharma medical affairs, Aipri bridges the gap between clinical necessity and technical excellence.
 



  





**What We Do** 




 We specialize in the technical design, material specification, and commercialization of premium surgical consumables, including advanced braided sutures (like Aicryl Polyglactin 910\) and surgical skin glue. Driven by a commitment to superior patient outcomes, we are aggressively expanding our product portfolio into a wider array of advanced medical instruments and devices.
 



  





**Our Vision \& Culture** 




 Our vision is to build Aipri into a highly respected, successful brand with a global reach. We are grounded in the core values of honesty, humility, intelligence, and kindness. At Aipri, we maintain a positive, realistic, and dependable work environment that respects the balance between ambitious business growth and personal peace of mind.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 Working at Aipri means joining a forward\-thinking, doctor\-led enterprise where your contributions directly impact the healthcare ecosystem. We offer structured compensation models, a clear strategic roadmap, and a collaborative environment where disciplined, dependable, and intellectually driven professionals can thrive and build a meaningful career.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Operation Theater (OT) Engagement:** 
 Spend active time in hospital OT environments, supporting surgeons and OT teams during product evaluation to build clinical confidence in Aipri’s suture portfolio.



  




* **Surgeon \& Specialty Coverage:** 
 Build and maintain direct relationships with key surgeons across multiple specialties (General Surgery, OB\-GYN, Orthopedics).



  




* **Territory \& Account Management:** 
 Map private hospitals, nursing homes, and day\-care surgical centers in assigned Ahmedabad clusters; identify new accounts and drive repeat orders.



  




* **Institutional \& Purchase Coordination:** 
 Engage Hospital Purchase Managers, Procurement Teams, and OT Sisters\-in\-Charge to facilitate product code listings, vendor registration, and seamless ordering.



  




* **Supply \& Delivery Support:** 
 Coordinate with the internal operations team to ensure direct, next\-day product delivery to hospital clients and manage local inventory needs.



  




* **Market \& Competitor Intelligence:** 
 Track local surgeon preference shifts, competitor activity, and hospital procurement dynamics, reporting field insights directly to leadership.



  





**Candidate Profile \& Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Biotechnology, or related fields.
* 1 to 3 years in Surgical Devices, Medical Consumables, OT Products, or Clinical Hospital Sales in Ahmedabad.
* Fully comfortable working within the Operation Theater (OT) environment and interacting directly with surgical teams.
* Existing contacts with surgeons, OT staff, and hospital purchase departments across key Ahmedabad surgical clusters.
* Strong scientific learning aptitude, relationship\-building skills, commercial negotiation ability, and high integrity.
* Must own a two\-wheeler with a valid driving license for daily local territory coverage.



  





**Field Working Structure \& Culture** 



* Working Days: Monday to Saturday.
* Field Timings: Aligned with surgeon availability and OT schedules (starts at 9:30 AM; flexible field wrap\-up based on daily doctor appointments and hospital rounds).
* Compensation: Competitive fixed salary (commensurate with experience) \+ Daily Local Conveyance Allowance (TA/DA) \+ Incentives.

* End\-to\-end sales
* Client relationship management

* Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

* Ability to communicate calmly and professionally with frustrated customers.
* Comfortable working with targets, CRM systems and structured follow\-ups.

Daily responsibilities include recommending destinations and experiences, preparing quotations, managing bookings for flights, stays, and activities, and ensuring all travel arrangements are accurate and timely. The Travel Sales Consultant will work closely with internal teams and partners to secure competitive rates, resolve booking issues, and contribute to sales targets and overall business growth.

* Proficiency in Travel Arrangements and Reservations, including flights, accommodations, and experiences.
* Demonstrated Customer Service skills with a customer\-first mindset and ability to handle inquiries and concerns professionally.

title: Head of Business Development
description:
**Company Description** 
 PrefDigiHub, founded in 2024, is an AI\-powered marketing partner focused on helping brands connect with their audiences in smarter, more impactful ways. The team combines creativity with data\-driven precision to deliver AI\-based SEO, content marketing, social media management, visual design, branding, and paid advertising solutions. PrefDigiHub emphasizes deep analysis, AI\-driven insights, and measurable growth over guesswork, supporting clients from start\-up to global enterprises. The company positions itself as a long\-term growth partner for tech start\-up's, e\-commerce businesses, and local brands seeking scalable digital marketing strategies.
 



  





 Job Description: Business Development Head 
 



**Experience:** 
 3\+ Years
 


**Role Overview** 

 We are seeking a hands\-on Business Development leader who thrives in a purely outbound sales environment. This is not a role for someone who relies on inbound leads; we need a self\-starter with a proven track record of hunting, pitching, and independently closing new international clients. You will have the autonomy to define the sales process, make strategic decisions, and build our pipeline from the ground up in new territories.
 



  




**Key Responsibilities** 
* **Process Definition \& Strategy:** 
 Independently design, document, and execute the end\-to\-end business development strategy for targeting clients in the USA, UK, Australia, and the Netherlands.
* **Outbound Lead Generation:** 
 Take a highly hands\-on approach to client acquisition through cold calling, LinkedIn outreach, and highly personalized email marketing campaigns.
* **End\-to\-End Sales:** 
 Own the entire sales cycle from initial data extraction and prospecting to pitching our digital marketing services, negotiating contracts, and successfully closing deals.
* **Tool Utilization:** 
 Leverage modern data scraping, lead enrichment, and CRM tools (e.g., Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to pull highly targeted prospect data.
* **Market Research \& Positioning:** 
 Understand international market trends, identify lucrative industries, and position PrefDigiHub’s digital marketing solutions to address their specific pain points.
* **Decision Making:** 
 Act autonomously to optimize outreach cadences, tweak sales messaging, and pivot strategies based on market response.



  




**Requirements \& Qualifications** 
* **Experience:** 
 Minimum of 3\+ years of proven experience in B2B Business Development or International IT/Agency Sales.
* **Outbound Expertise:** 
 A demonstrable track record of independently generating leads and closing international clients without relying on inbound marketing channels.
* **Hands\-On Skills:** 
 Deep, practical experience with LinkedIn networking, crafting high\-converting cold emails, and confident cold calling.
* **Tech\-Savvy:** 
 Strong knowledge of the latest lead generation, data extraction, and sales automation tools in the market.
* **Industry Knowledge:** 
 A solid understanding of the Digital Marketing landscape (SEO, Performance Marketing, Meta/Google Ads) to effectively communicate our value proposition to C\-level executives and business owners.
* **Soft Skills:** 
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, aggressive yet consultative selling approach, and strong negotiation capabilities.
* **Leadership Mindset:** 
 Highly decisive and capable of building a repeatable sales process from scratch.



  




**What We Offer** 
* The opportunity to lead and shape the international expansion of a growing agency.
* Autonomy in decision\-making and defining your own sales architecture.
* Competitive compensation with an attractive, performance\-based commission structure.

title: Real Estate Sales Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




**We are looking for an experienced and results\-driven Sales Manager – Commercial Real Estate to lead and strengthen our sales function for current and upcoming commercial projects.** 




**The ideal candidate will have 10\+ years of experience in real estate sales, with mandatory experience in commercial real estate, along with a strong understanding of the Ahmedabad market and an established network of Channel Partners (CPs), brokers, investors, and clients.** 




  





**About the role** 




 We're hiring a Sales Manager to own commercial sales end to end — from channel partner activation to site visit to closure and collection. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you'll run a small sales team, bring structure and reporting discipline to the function, and make sure Ahmedabad's channel partner community is consistently bringing clients to our projects.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Own the full sales cycle: lead generation, site visits, negotiation, closure, and post\-booking coordination with legal and finance
* Build and maintain an active channel partner network around every live project — regular CP meets, project briefings, incentive programs, and quick turnaround on CP leads
* coach, and motivate the sales team; set daily and weekly targets and hold the team to them
* Set up and run the reporting cadence: CP activity tracker, customer follow\-up pipeline, weekly funnel review with management
* Act as the face of the company at site — walkthroughs, investor meetings, broker presentations,
* Feed market intelligence (pricing, competing inventory, CP sentiment) back to management



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 6–10 years in real estate sales, with at least 3 years selling commercial (office/retail) inventory for a developer in Ahmedabad
* A strong, active network of channel partners across the city — you should be able to name them
* Track record of leading a sales team, not just closing personally
* Confident, outgoing, and presentable — comfortable in front of HNI investors, corporate occupiers, and brokers alike
* Process\-minded: you've run a CRM or structured tracker and can report on funnel health without being asked
* Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi, and English



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Organize, structure, and strengthen the sales infrastructure for current and upcoming commercial projects.
* Build, manage, and expand a strong Channel Partner (CP) and broker network across Ahmedabad.
* Drive end\-to\-end sales closures for office spaces, retail spaces, and mixed\-use developments.
* Work closely with senior management on pricing strategy, inventory planning, and sales forecasting.
* Monitor sales performance, pipeline movement, lead conversion, and closure ratios.
* Handle high\-value client interactions, negotiations, and key investor relationships.
* Conduct and participate in broker meets, client meetings, site visits, and strategic business discussions.
* Develop strong relationships with channel partners and ensure consistent business generation.
* Ensure effective follow\-up and movement of prospects through the complete sales cycle.
* Prepare regular sales reports and performance updates for senior management.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* 6\-10 years of proven experience in real estate sales.
* Mandatory experience in commercial real estate sales.
* Strong leadership experience in managing and developing sales teams.
* Strong existing broker / Channel Partner network in Ahmedabad.
* In\-depth understanding of the Ahmedabad commercial real estate market.
* Excellent negotiation, presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong client and investor relationship\-management abilities.
* Highly target\-oriented with a strong closure mindset.
* Ability to develop and execute effective sales strategies.
* Strong analytical and decision\-making skills.



  





**Qualification** 



* Graduate in any discipline.



  





**Language Requirements** 



* The candidate must be locally based in Ahmedabad and must know Gujarati and should speak Hindi, \& English.



**Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* Compensation will be commensurate with experience, expertise, and proven performance.

title: District Sales Executive
description:
We take care of our employees, and they take care of our customers!
   

  

 Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service\-based approach to logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350\+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.
   

  

 Our Mission
   

  

 We recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over.
 **We love to promote from within** 
 \- more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs \- they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 The focus of the District Sales Executive (DSE) is on achieving results that are aligned with the overall organization and it's strategic goals. Initiative, coupled with a sense of competitive drive, and the ability to stay focused on results despite changing conditions, are the keys to achieving the performance objectives of the District Sales Executive role at Expeditors.
   

  

 The DSE orchestrates involvement of multiple people in our Sales process, so that new customer revenue is consistently secured for our district office and Expeditors network. The job environment is flexible, constantly changing, and provides growth opportunity, recognition and reward for the achievement of business results. This position reports to the District Sales Manager.
   

  

**Key Deliverables**
 These are the minimum results expected from a successful District Sales Executive:
   

  

* Manage an assigned territory and demonstrate extensive knowledge of potential customers and competitors in this area
* Timely data entry in our Customer Relationship Management tool
* Orchestrate customer / branch relationships and collaborate with regional Product, Service, Geo, and Knowledge Management resources
* Participate in the creation of value\-added solutions for customer's logistics needs, including supporting diagrams and cost\-benefit calculations
* Support the transition of new accounts through customer introductions, information transfer, and securing any necessary customer paperwork. When needed, support AR (accounts receivable) collection.
* Attend training \& development sessions to continue developing selling skills and updating Expeditors Product and Service knowledge
* Involvement in local trade groups, as directed by the District Sales Manager
* Take on additional assignments as required, supporting company needs


**Qualifications**
* The ability to meet with customers off\-site on a regular basis
* Oral and written proficiency in the English language
* Strong problem solving, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work productively both individually and in a team environment
* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Self\-motivated with ability to work in a fast\-paced and constantly changing environment
* Comfortable with regular data entry on a laptop computer
* Strong rapport and relationship\-building focused
* Empowered to make quick decisions in response to changing conditions
* Extroverted, confident, enthusiastic and persuasive
* Influences others to action
* Timeliness and accountability for results


**Additional Information**
 Expeditors offers excellent benefits:
   

  

* Paid Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time
* Health Plan: Medical
* Life Insurance
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Training and Personnel Development Program
* Growth opportunities within the company
* Employee Referral Program Bonus

description:

**Adani Group:** 
 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O\&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

* Process debit and credit notes associated with sales transactions to maintain complete and accurate financial documentation

* Prepare and manage PIS (Packed in slip) records
* Manage delivery orders, financial books, debit, and credit notes
* Process ledger entries such as LC (Letter of Credit) clearing
* Manage port reconciliations, provisions, and entries

 Support comprehensive digitization strategies to optimise operational efficiency

* Finance and accounting
* Marketing
* Operations

 Customers
   

  

 Suppliers/ Vendors

**Education Qualification:**
* Post\-Graduation (Finance)


**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
* 0\-5 Years of experience


**Preferred Industry**
* Coal Trading, Commodity Trading

title: E-COMMERCE & MARKETPLACE EXECUTIVE
description:
**WE’RE HIRING: E\-COMMERCE \& MARKETPLACE EXECUTIVE** 




 📍 Gota, Ahmedabad \| Full\-time \| Work from Office
 



 💼 Experience: 1–3 years
 



  





**About Gracia Marcom** 




 Gracia Marcom is a purpose\-driven advertising, marketing and business\-growth company helping brands launch, manage and scale across Indian and international markets.
 



 We are building a disciplined, ambitious and people\-centred team where individuals receive the autonomy to take ownership, the challenges to develop competence and the support to grow professionally and personally.
 



  





**Why Are We Hiring for This Position?** 




 We are looking for an E\-commerce \& Marketplace Executive – Domestic and International who can manage and grow brands across online marketplaces and their own e\-commerce websites.
 



 This is not merely a product\-uploading or order\-processing position. You will be responsible for improving product visibility, customer experience, sales, operational accuracy and profitability across multiple digital commerce channels.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage day\-to\-day operations across marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Walmart, eBay, Etsy and other relevant Indian and international platforms.
* Manage brand\-owned e\-commerce websites built on Shopify, WooCommerce or similar platforms.
* Create, update and optimize product listings, categories, collections, attributes, variations, pricing and inventory.
* Coordinate product descriptions, images, videos, enhanced content, landing pages and marketplace\-specific brand content.
* Conduct keyword research and optimize listings and website content for better search visibility and conversion.
* Manage marketplace advertising and coordinate paid campaigns for e\-commerce websites.
* Monitor sales, traffic, conversion rates, average order value, advertising performance, return rates and profitability.
* Coordinate inventory availability, stock planning, order fulfilment and replenishment.
* Manage marketplace fulfilment models such as FBA and coordinate with warehouses, courier companies and logistics partners.
* Monitor website functionality, product pages, payment gateways, checkout flow, discount codes and customer experience.
* Identify and resolve listing, catalogue, order, payment, inventory and account\-health issues.
* Coordinate with marketplace support teams and technology partners to resolve operational problems.
* Support new product launches, seasonal campaigns, offers and international market expansion.
* Study competitors, pricing, keywords, customer reviews and category trends to identify growth opportunities.
* Coordinate with content, design, advertising, inventory, finance, customer\-support and logistics teams.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with clear insights, action points and measurable outcomes.
* Recommend ways to increase sales, visibility, conversion, customer retention and profitability.



  





**What Does the Right Person Look Like?** 




 You may be a strong fit if you:
 


* Have 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in e\-commerce or marketplace management.
* Have worked with platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, WooCommerce, Walmart, eBay, Etsy or similar channels.
* Understand product listings, cataloguing, variants, pricing, inventory and order management.
* Have practical knowledge of marketplace advertising or e\-commerce performance marketing.
* Understand website merchandising, landing pages, checkout experience and conversion optimization.
* Can work comfortably with sales data, dashboards and performance reports.
* Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Can investigate operational problems and follow them through until they are resolved.
* Communicate clearly in written and spoken English.
* Can coordinate effectively with multiple internal teams and external partners.
* Think beyond completing tasks and actively identify opportunities for commercial growth.



 Experience with international marketplaces, cross\-border e\-commerce, D2C websites or international fulfilment will be preferred.
 



  





**Our Value System** 




  





 Disciplined Execution
 



 You turn plans into reliable action, respect timelines and close tasks without requiring repeated follow\-ups.
 



  





 Empowered Autonomy
 



 You are given the freedom to make decisions—and are expected to take responsibility for their outcomes.
 



  





 Growth Through Challenge
 



 You are willing to learn new platforms, solve unfamiliar problems and build competence through responsibility.
 



  





 Purposeful Alignment
 



 You understand that e\-commerce growth must create sustainable value for the client, the organisation and your own professional journey.
 



  





 Co\-creation of an Ecosystem for Deeper Interests
 



 We encourage you to contribute ideas, explore your strengths and develop expertise beyond the limits of a narrowly defined role.
 



  





 We also believe in open conversations, empathetic leadership, psychological safety and employee wellbeing. High standards and a supportive workplace can—and should—coexist.
 



  





**Where Can This Position Lead?** 




 A strong performer can grow into roles such as:
 


* Senior E\-commerce Executive
* Marketplace Manager
* D2C E\-commerce Manager
* International E\-commerce Manager
* E\-commerce Growth Strategist
* Head of E\-commerce



 Your growth will depend on the ownership you demonstrate, the systems you build and the measurable commercial results you create.
 



  





**Company Size \& Vibe Check** 




 We are a growing, hands\-on team—not a large company where responsibilities disappear between departments.
 



 You will work closely with decision\-makers, receive meaningful responsibility and see the direct impact of your work. Our environment is fast\-moving, ambitious, collaborative and execution\-focused. We take our commitments seriously while maintaining open communication and space for people to grow.
 



  





**Please Do Not Apply If** 



* Your experience is limited to uploading products or processing orders.
* You have only theoretical knowledge and no hands\-on e\-commerce experience.
* You require continuous follow\-ups to complete routine responsibilities.
* You avoid accountability when a listing, campaign, order or website issue occurs.
* You only execute instructions and do not examine sales, conversion or profitability.
* You are uncomfortable working with data, reports or performance targets.
* You repeatedly escalate problems without first investigating possible solutions.
* You are unwilling to learn new marketplaces, tools or e\-commerce platforms.
* You are not comfortable working full\-time from our Gota, Ahmedabad office.
* You are looking only for a job title rather than an opportunity to take ownership and grow.


- 


**Work Arrangement** 




 This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office position at Gota, Ahmedabad. We see working from the office as an opportunity to collaborate closely, learn faster and build stronger systems together.
 



  





**How to Apply:** 




 Send your updated résumé along with brief answers to the following questions:
 


1. Which marketplaces and e\-commerce platforms have you personally managed?
2. Have you managed a Shopify, WooCommerce or another e\-commerce website?
3. What approximate monthly sales or advertising budget did you handle?
4. Describe one marketplace or website\-related problem you solved independently.
5. What measurable improvement did you achieve in sales, conversion, advertising performance or profitability?
6. What are your current CTC, expected CTC and earliest joining date?



  





 Please apply only if you are serious about building multi\-channel e\-commerce expertise and taking end\-to\-end ownership of performance.

 \#\# U.S. B2B Growth \& ABM Specialist
 



  





 \*\*Position:\*\* U.S. B2B Growth \& ABM Specialist
 



 \*\*Mission:\*\* Build the 0→1 U.S. Pipeline Engine
 



 \*\*Company / Target:\*\* AIS Technolabs \| United States Target Market

 \-\-\-
 



  





 \#\# 1\. Executive Overview
 



  





 AIS Technolabs is a rapidly expanding technology and IT services firm delivering end\-to\-end solutions across AI/ML, custom software development, mobile/web applications, cloud, CRM, MVP product development, and enterprise digital transformation.
 



  





 As part of our aggressive expansion into the U.S. market, we are transitioning from an inbound and portal\-bidding model to a proactive, highly targeted, account\-based demand\-generation engine.
 



  





 We have an established Business Development Representative (BDR) team actively running outreach (LinkedIn messaging, cold email, data enrichment via Apollo.io, CRM workflows).
 



  





 We are now hiring the strategic growth architect who will design, optimize, and power the engine behind that team.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 \#\# 2\. Core Objective \& Role Philosophy
 



  





 This is \*\*NOT\*\* a traditional SDR/BDR, cold caller, social media manager, or generic digital marketing role.
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on GTM operator and pipeline builder who owns the following strategic chain end\-to\-end:
 



 \|
 



 \-\-\-
 



  





 \#\# 3\. Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \#\#\# 1\. U.S. Market \& ICP Strategy
 



  





 \* Define and continuously refine AIS Technolabs' Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) for the U.S. market segment.
 



 \* Segment accounts based on company size, funding stage, tech stack, hiring velocity, business model, and active buying intent.
 



 \* Identify key U.S. C\-suite and VP\-level decision\-makers (CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, VP of Engineering, VP of Product, Digital Transformation Leaders).
 



  





 \#\#\# 2\. Account\-Based Marketing (ABM) \& Intent Workflows
 



  





 \* Design and execute high\-touch U.S. ABM campaigns using platforms like Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Clay.
 



 \* Track account\-level buying signals including funding rounds, executive turnover, active tech modernization initiatives, AI adoption, cloud migration, and tech stack shifts.
 



 \* Develop tailored, account\-specific strategies rather than executing generic blast campaigns.
 



  





 \#\#\# 3\. Focused Offer \& Demand Generation
 



  





 \* Turn core capabilities (AI/ML Development, Custom Software, MVP Engineering, App Modernization, Dedicated Engineering Teams, Automation) into high\-converting commercial offers.
 



 \* Identify specific vertical opportunities rather than marketing all IT services simultaneously.
 



  





 \#\#\# 4\. End\-to\-End Campaign Development
 



  





 \* Own campaigns end\-to\-end: ICP → Target Accounts → Messaging → Offer → Content → Landing Page Briefs → Outreach → Lead Nurture → BDR Handoff → Opportunity.
 



 \* Build multi\-touch messaging sequences across cold email, LinkedIn, and targeted digital assets.
 



 \* Conduct continuous A/B testing on offers, copy, and distribution channels to maximize conversion.
 



  





 \#\#\# 5\. BDR Enablement \& Operational Alignment
 



  





 \* Supply BDRs with verified account lists, detailed buyer personas, trigger\-event context, personalized copy angles, and follow\-up playbooks.
 



 \* Serve as the strategic force multiplier to double BDR productivity and outbound meeting conversion rates.
 



  





 \#\#\# 6\. Tech Stack \& Automation Architecture
 



  





 \* Manage and optimize GTM technologies: Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot/Salesforce, Clay, Instantly/Smartlead, Make/Zapier, and AI enrichment platforms.
 



 \* Build scalable workflows connecting data enrichment, lead scoring, BDR task assignments, and CRM pipeline tracking.
 



  





 \#\#\# 7\. Paid \& Account\-Based Acquisition
 



  





 \* Support targeted paid campaigns (LinkedIn Ads, Google Search, Retargeting, ABM Display) focused strictly on acquiring qualified pipeline over vanity impressions.
 



  





 \#\#\# 8\. Sales Collateral \& Thought Leadership
 



  





 \* Translate complex technical solutions into crisp business outcome messaging for U.S. executives.
 



 \* Oversee creation of one\-pagers, ROI calculators, case study briefs, executive decks, and lead magnets.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Holiday Chacha Pvt. Ltd., operating as Holiday Planner since 2002, specializes in personalized travel solutions that turn individual travel dreams into memorable experiences. The company offers end\-to\-end services, including holiday packages, hotel bookings, flights, visas, and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions). With a strong customer\-first approach, Holiday Planner focuses on building long\-term relationships by putting smiles before sales. Its core values emphasize authenticity, reliability, and excellence, ensuring honest itineraries, dependable service, and high standards in every trip.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Sales Executive role is based in Jodhpur. The Sales Executive will engage with prospective and existing customers to understand their travel needs, present suitable holiday packages and services, and close sales in line with company goals. Day\-to\-day activities include responding to inquiries, preparing quotations, following up on leads, maintaining accurate sales records, and coordinating with operations and ticketing teams to ensure smooth service delivery. The role also involves building strong client relationships, meeting sales targets, and representing the company’s customer\-first values in all interactions.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to convert leads into bookings and achieve targets.
* Customer service and communication skills, including clear spoken and written English and Hindi, and a professional, client\-focused approach.
* Basic knowledge of travel industry products and processes, such as holiday packages, hotels, flights, and visas (experience in MICE is an advantage).
* Proficiency in using computers and common office tools (e.g., email, spreadsheets, CRM or booking systems) for day\-to\-day sales activities.
* Ability to work on\-site in Jodhpur, manage time effectively, and collaborate with internal teams.
* Prior experience in travel or hospitality sales preferred but not mandatory; enthusiasm to learn and grow in the travel sector is highly valued.
* Minimum educational qualification: bachelor’s degree or equivalent; relevant diplomas in travel, tourism, or hospitality will be considered an asset.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Euroasia Aquatic Private Limited is a trusted partner for compliance, certification, and business growth, serving clients in Ahmedabad and across India. The company simplifies government compliance for entrepreneurs, startups, and MSMEs, offering end\-to\-end support for Start\-up India, ZED, and GEM registration. Its services cover tax exemption support, annual company filings, and legal advisory, including ROC, LLP, and MSME documentation. Euroasia Aquatic also provides tender search and bid submission support, along with digital marketing solutions such as website design, SEO, and GMB setup to help certified businesses grow online. The organization is focused on helping clients become compliant, verified, and ready for sustainable growth.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for identifying and nurturing new business opportunities, building strong relationships with entrepreneurs, startups, and MSMEs, and promoting Euroasia Aquatic’s compliance, certification, and digital marketing services. Day\-to\-day tasks include prospecting and lead generation, conducting client meetings and consultations, preparing proposals, coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery, and tracking sales performance against targets. The Business Development Manager will also monitor market trends, participate in networking events, and provide feedback to management on service improvement and potential new offerings.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in business development, sales, and client relationship management.
* Ability to understand and communicate government compliance, certification processes, and legal documentation requirements (such as Start\-up India, ZED, GEM, ROC, LLP, MSME).
* Familiarity with tender search, bid submission, and basic digital marketing concepts (website design, SEO, online business promotion) to support client growth strategies.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain complex services in a clear and engaging manner.
* Proven organizational and time management skills, including managing multiple clients and projects simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent post\-graduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in business development, B2B sales, or professional services (compliance, legal, consulting, or digital marketing) is highly beneficial.
* Comfort working in an on\-site environment in Ahmedabad, with readiness for field visits, client meetings, and networking activities as needed.

 We are proud to be a 100% subsidiary of bioMérieux SA, based in Marcy L'Etoile, France, and have been serving the Indian market for over 25 years. With our comprehensive diagnostic solutions in clinical microbiology, immunology, molecular biology, and industrial microbiology, we cater to over 5000\+ customers. Our offerings provide essential information to healthcare professionals and industry players, addressing critical areas such as antimicrobial resistance, sepsis, acute care syndromic approaches, and food safety. Through these efforts, we aim to protect the health of patients and consumers.
   

  

 By joining bioMérieux, you become a part of an innovative company with a long\-term vision, deeply committed to serving public health. Our corporate culture emphasizes a humanistic approach, and we are driven by a pioneering spirit.
   

  

 We seek candidates who are motivated to invest in themselves, contribute to future projects, and be part of a collective adventure led by a pioneering spirit. Join us as we work towards a healthier future for all.
   

  

**Location:**
**Position:** 
 Sales Executive
   

  

**Education \& Experience**
**Minimum:** 
 Graduate in any Life Sciences
   

  

**Desirable:** 
 Postgraduate in any Life Sciences
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1\-3 years’ experience in IVD sales (Equipment, Reagent or Service)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Achievement of the Target Objectives for the respective territory, including sales and collection and effective collaboration with the customer service Team (FAS \& FSE) and all other available resources. Accurate forecast of sales for respective territory by period based on a strong understanding of the pipeline.
* Timely payment collection and control of DSO to meet Objectives for the year.
* Use CRM as a tool to manage the Accounts in planning, scheduling, and implementation of actions to achieve the Objectives set. Maximize coverage and focus on Accounts in the territory.
* Develop a deep understanding of the market, Accounts and competition sharing this with the Reporting Manager and Marketing Team.
* Develop strong and professional customer relationships: work as a partner to customers to help them adopt and realise the full potential of our solutions. Be an Ambassador for the Company.


**Job Description**
* Be accountable for the achievement of the Target and all Objectives set for the year. Perform actions throughout the year to ensure the achievement of results in terms of sales (ERS \& SBS), DSO and profitability.
* Develop an action plan for Territory coverage so that all Accounts are met by all the stakeholders at regular intervals and that adequate calls and activities are planned for the period to achieve the objectives set for Accounts.
* Interact with the dealers in the territory in coordination with the Reporting Manager and Dealer. Evaluate the requirement for new dealers and recommend with business rationale to the reporting manager.
* Gain a clear understanding of the Pricing document and maintain the sanctity of the Company pricing policies.
* Accurately forecast sales in the Territory on a month\-by\-month basis using precise market and customer information, validated pipeline projections and knowledge of the opportunities.
* Be fully aware of and stringently follow all Company Policies, principles and SOPs.
* Network with healthcare professionals in the territory and to increase bioMerieux visibility. Identify and develop KOLs within the Region and work to conduct effective CME programs.
* Systematically ensure that complete documentation is done and maintain all records of official correspondence and documentation including proposals, customer pricelists, reports related to Accounts in the local / head office.
* Ensure ethical and compliant behaviour at all times of self and Team members.


**Key Deliverables**
* Achievement of 100\+ % of budgeted A/B for sales in territory.
* Achievement of DSO and profitability targets in territory.
* Develop and sustain the business of the territory.
* Strong brand image for bioMerieux as a high medical value solutions provider, a fair player and a good employer.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
Job Summary
 



 We are seeking an experienced and performance\-driven Area Sales Manager to lead sales operations and business development activities in the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, managing key customer relationships, expanding market presence, and achieving sales objectives for laboratory chemicals, reagents, and raw materials. The role requires strong leadership skills, strategic planning, team coordination, and extensive customer engagement across industries such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, research institutions, educational organizations, and manufacturing sectors.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and execute territory sales strategies to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
* Drive business growth by identifying and developing new customers, distributors, and market opportunities.
* Manage and strengthen relationships with key accounts, institutional customers, and strategic clients.
* Lead, mentor, and support Sales Officers/Executives within the assigned region.
* Conduct regular customer visits, business reviews, product presentations, and negotiations.
* Promote the company's portfolio of laboratory chemicals, reagents, solvents, and raw materials.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing strategies, and customer requirements.
* Collaborate with internal teams including Customer Support, Logistics, Finance, and Marketing to ensure seamless customer service.
* Prepare sales forecasts, territory plans, MIS reports, and business performance reviews.
* Ensure timely payment collections and maintain healthy receivables.
* Participate in industry exhibitions, seminars, and customer engagement programs.
* Drive customer retention and enhance overall customer satisfaction.



  





 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's Degree in Science, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of sales experience in chemicals, laboratory reagents, pharmaceuticals, scientific products, or related industries.
* Proven experience in territory management and business development.
* Experience in handling key accounts and managing regional sales operations.
* Strong understanding of B2B sales, channel management, and customer relationship management.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ariix Chemicals is the specialty chemicals division of ARIIX Products India Pvt. Ltd., providing high\-performance chemical solutions to domestic and international customers. From its ISO\-certified manufacturing facility in Panoli GIDC, Gujarat, the company serves diverse industries including personal care, textiles, pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, industrial cleaning, and construction chemicals. Ariix Chemicals manages the full value chain from raw material sourcing to final delivery, ensuring consistency, quality, and reliable supply. Backed by strong research and development, quality assurance, and export\-ready operations, the company focuses on innovation and long\-term customer relationships. As customer needs evolve, Ariix Chemicals continues to invest in advanced capabilities, technologies, and talent to deliver specialty chemical solutions that create lasting value.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, expanding the customer base, and strengthening existing client relationships in key chemical industry segments. This full\-time, on\-site role in Ahmedabad includes conducting market research, mapping potential customers, preparing and presenting proposals, and negotiating commercial terms in alignment with company objectives. The role involves close collaboration with internal teams such as technical, production, and supply chain to ensure customer requirements are met and opportunities are converted into long\-term partnerships. The Business Development Manager will also track sales performance, prepare regular reports, contribute to pricing strategies, and represent the company at industry events and customer meetings. A focus on consultative selling, solution\-oriented engagement, and maintaining high standards of professionalism and transparency is essential.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong business development and B2B sales skills in chemicals or related manufacturing industries, including lead generation, account management, and negotiation.
* Solid market research and analytical abilities to understand industry trends, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage technical and commercial stakeholders and build long\-term relationships.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams (technical, production, logistics, quality) to align customer needs with internal capabilities.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), and basic data reporting for sales tracking and forecasting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in specialty chemicals, industrial products, or allied sectors, with knowledge of export and domestic market operations, is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, travel for client meetings as required, and uphold ethical, non\-discriminatory professional conduct.
